name: Being a Wife
source:
This is a 3D female protagonist choice-based visual novel game where you take on the character of Christine Watson, a happily married middle-aged lady. Her spouse has found a new job after losing his previous one.

Christine has an 18-year-old son and a beautiful daughter. Christine has always desired to live an exciting life; yet, owing to a lack of funds, she may have to discover a variety of other ways to make her life simpler and more adventurous.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085642/https://boosty.to/baap]Boosty[/url]]
